applies_to: Neptronic SKH4 high-pressure water atomizing humidifiers and evaporative coolers with up to six zones (A-F).
summary: The SKH4 pumps treated water to high-pressure nozzles for humidification or adiabatic cooling, serving up to six zones. BACnet MS/TP and BACnet IP are built in; besides system control sources and network RH/temperature inputs the guide lists per-zone control, occupancy, demand, readings, stage and communication objects.
notes: Objects and their writable properties are taken from the guide's 'W?' column; Present_Value writable means the BMS can change it.
Units follow the BACnet Server Units setting (Metric or Imperial).
Zone B-F objects only apply when those zones are configured.
MSV 101 is printed as MAV.101 in the guide; it is a multi-state value.

source.title: SKH4 High-Pressure Atomizer BACnet Communication Module User Guide

integration.summary: Choose a Network control profile (MSV 28) or demand source (MSV 43 = Network) and write demand to AV 138, or feed room RH/temperature readings (AV 106 / AV 155) for internal control. Per-zone control and occupancy are set with the Zone MSVs; watch BV 44 and the zone communication timeout BVs.

minimum_points.name: System Power State
minimum_points.why: On/off status (read-only here; no BMS on/off command)

integration.enable: No writable system on/off object is listed (MSV 83 System Power State is read-only in this guide). Zones are switched with the Zone x Control MSVs (1 = Off, 2 = Normal...) and Zone x Occupancy; the demand source comes from MSV 28 / MSV 43.
integration.heartbeat: AV 223 Network Timeout (1-900 s) is how long the unit tries to reach the BACnet or Modbus network before it stops operating; BV 44 Network Control State shows 1 = Fault. AV 441 sets the internal zone communication timeout, with per-zone alarms BV 86-91.
integration.remote_sensors: Network room RH to AV 106 (MSV 33 = Network) with setpoints AV 107-109; room temperature to AV 155 for cooling profiles; supply high limit RH to AV 122 (MSV 38 = Network) and temperature to AV 175 (MSV 71 = Network). Direct demand goes to AV 138 and high limit to AV 139.
setup: MS/TP MAC defaults to 1 (000-254; 128-254 are non-token-passing slaves); baud rate auto-detects (Auto, 9600, 19200, 38400, 76800); Max_Master 127.
Device instance defaults to 153000 + MAC (153001 out of the box) and can be changed from the menu or by writing Device Object_Identifier.
BACnet IP uses UDP 47808 (0xBAC0) by default.
Network/communication settings are in the controller's Integration menu (password 5544); power-cycle after connecting to the network.
Reinitialize Device (warm/cold reset) over BACnet uses the password 'nep'.
gotchas: MSV 'BACnet Server List Mode' chooses which objects are published (Integrator, Advanced, Factory); objects marked Advanced in the guide, such as the program objects, only show in Advanced mode.
Writing Out_of_Service = True disconnects an object from its physical input so the Present_Value can be overwritten; remember to set it back.
The unit signals alarms through object values only; it does not send BACnet event notifications, so poll or use COV.
COV subscriptions are lost on a power cycle.
Many AVs in this guide are commandable (Relinquish_Default listed); write at a consistent priority.
